single_priority.source: The Odds API v4 current odds
single_priority.why_first: Robin has historical fixtures/results but no local intraday odds snapshot corpus and no historical receipt objects. This source is the highest-scoring class-C candidate, fits the existing sport-key/market concepts, has provider last-update fields, permits analytics under published terms, and can start within the public Starter credit allowance after approval.
data: totals price/point pairs filtered analytically to 2.5 without discarding raw response

markets.deferral_reason: First prove receipt completeness, fixture identity, coverage and quota economics on two high-value featured markets.

frequency.policy: Capture once per competition/window, not continuous polling.
frequency.window_tolerance_scope: Applies to J-7, J-3, J-1, H-6 and H-2 only.
frequency.near_kickoff_definition: Target kickoff minus 15 minutes; accepted one-sided interval [kickoff-20m, kickoff-10m]. Outside that interval record MISSED_WINDOW. At or after kickoff quarantine as POST_KICKOFF and never substitute it for NEAR_KICKOFF.
frequency.retry_policy: No blind retry after a valid response; each response, including partial/empty, receives its own receipt. Network retries use bounded backoff and a new observation timestamp.

monetary.plan: Starter, if the public 500-credit/month allowance and pricing remain unchanged

expected_cost.guardrail: Do not call if remaining credits cannot cover the response plus reserve; re-check price/terms before approval and every renewal.

expected_volume.why_unknown: Response size and bookmaker/market availability are dynamic and must be measured by the first approved snapshot; no paid/authenticated call was made in this mission.

request_identity_template.secret_handling: API key is neither stored in request_identity nor logged; secret value must never enter Git or receipts.
request_identity_template.endpoint_note: Use the provider's documented authenticated endpoint only after separate activation approval.

receipt_contract.source_published_at_rule: Set null on the response-level receipt because the current-odds response has no single documented publication timestamp. On each bookmaker child projection, preserve last_update as source_published_at only when its provider semantics and clock checks pass.
receipt_contract.available_at_rule: Response receipt: robin_first_observed_at. Bookmaker child: max(trusted bookmaker last_update, receipt robin_first_observed_at); if last_update is missing/untrusted, use robin_first_observed_at and record the downgrade; never earlier than either.
receipt_contract.immutability: Payload bytes and receipt are append-only; later provider states create new snapshot candidates.
receipt_contract.admission_rule: A quote is usable for a feature only when receipt is complete, payload hash verifies, fixture mapping is unambiguous and available_at <= feature_cutoff_at.

first_snapshot.scope: One approved GET for the next verified Ligue 1 matchday at its first due J-7 window; if J-7 is already past, use the next due window and label it exactly rather than backdating.
first_snapshot.raw_storage: Immutable storage outside Git; production store and retention approval are separate decisions.
first_snapshot.receipt_storage: Store adjacent to payload and in a queryable receipt index only after separate implementation approval.
first_snapshot.no_backfill_rule: The first real robin_first_observed_at is capture time; never assign it to earlier matches or existing legacy odds.

success_criteria: HTTP 200 response and exact payload bytes retained with matching SHA-256 and byte count.
One complete receipt with all 12 LOOP55-compatible required fields and an immutable capture_code_revision.
At least one provider event maps uniquely to a verified Ligue 1 fixture without name-only ambiguity.
Every admitted h2h bookmaker has home, draw and away outcomes; every admitted O/U projection identifies its point and both sides.
At least five bookmakers provide complete h2h for at least 80% of returned mapped fixtures; lower coverage is retained but the pilot is classified insufficient.
All source and Robin timestamps normalize to UTC; any future clock skew or missing source timestamp is quarantined/downgraded; NEAR_KICKOFF is accepted only in [T-20m, T-10m].
A no-network replay from stored bytes reproduces the schema fingerprint, fixture/market projections and payload hash exactly.
Secrets, authorization headers and raw payload bodies are absent from Git/log artifacts.
Actual credits used, response bytes, event count, bookmaker count, market completeness and schema drift are measured against the estimate.
single_priority.scale_gate: Scale to the full five-league schedule only after two matchdays, at least five fixtures and at least two critical windows pass all receipt/replay criteria, legal retention is confirmed, monthly peak credits remain below allowance plus reserve, and no production lock is bypassed.

replaces: The empty 86-row odds archive ledger as evidence of capture
Semantic opening/closing labels as a substitute for exact observed-at snapshots
Any plan to infer intraday movement from data/matches.parquet
delays: API-Football player availability expansion unless written rights clearance is obtained

non_actions_confirmed: No API key read or used.
No authenticated or paid provider call made.
No purchase, subscription or activation performed.
No Robin source, workflow, database, R2 object or production lock changed.
